            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "title: \"Car Stalls at Idle: What to Check First\"",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "excerpt: \"Your engine dies every time you come to a stop. Before you start replacing parts randomly, here's a logical, step-by-step approach to finding and fixing the most common causes of idle stalling.\"",

            "text": "draft: true",

            "lineNumber": 5

          },

            "lineNumber": 14
          },

            "text": "  time: \"30-90 min\"",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "  diyCost: \"$0-$100\"",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "  shopCost: \"$100-$500\"",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "  skill: \"intermediate\"",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "  notes: \"Throttle body cleaning and MAF sensor cleaning are easy. Vacuum leak diagnosis takes patience.\"",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "safetyLevel: low",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "partsNeeded:",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },

            "text": "  - \"Throttle body cleaner\"",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  - \"MAF sensor cleaner\"",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  - \"Replacement IAC valve (if faulty)\"",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  - \"Vacuum hoses (if cracked)\"",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "toolsNeeded:",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "  - \"Basic socket set and screwdrivers\"",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },

            "lineNumber": 28
          },

            "lineNumber": 29
          },

            "text": "  - \"Propane torch or carb cleaner (for vacuum leak detection)\"",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },

            "lineNumber": 31

            "lineNumber": 33

            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  - \"P0300\"",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  - \"P0101\"",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "topics:",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "  - idle",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  - stalling",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "  - throttle-body",

          {
            "text": "  - engine",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "seo:",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "  description: \"Car stalls at idle or dies at stop lights? Learn how to diagnose and fix the most common causes — dirty throttle body, vacuum leaks, IAC valve, and more — in your driveway.\"",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "import FixFlow from '@/components/mdx/FixFlow.astro'",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "import SafetyCallout from '@/components/mdx/SafetyCallout.astro'",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "import ToolsParts from '@/components/mdx/ToolsParts.astro'",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "import Callout from '@/components/mdx/Callout.astro'",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "import CostComparison from '@/components/mdx/CostComparison.astro'",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "import AffiliateProduct from '@/components/mdx/AffiliateProduct.astro'",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "You're sitting at a red light and the engine just… quits. Or it stumbles and nearly dies when you shift into drive. Idle stalling is one of the most common driveability complaints, and while it feels alarming, the cause is usually something simple and fixable.",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "Your engine needs three things to idle smoothly: the right amount of air, the right amount of fuel, and a reliable spark. When idle stalling happens, one of those three is off. Let's figure out which one.",
            "lineNumber": 60
          }
        ]
      },
